name: kml-expect-version
description: EXPECT VERSION is an optimistic-concurrency guard: a matching version writes and bumps, a stale one aborts the whole statement atomically with KIP_3005, and EXPECT VERSION 0 is create-only.
setup: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?drug_type { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Drug"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Pharmaceutical drug concept type" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_setup", "confidence": 1.0 } }

UPSERT { CONCEPT ?symptom_type { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Symptom"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Medical symptom concept type" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_setup", "confidence": 1.0 } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?treats_pred { {type: "$PropositionType", name: "treats"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Treatment relationship" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_setup", "confidence": 1.0 } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?headache { {type: "Symptom", name: "Headache"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "severity": "moderate", "duration": "2-4 hours" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_data", "confidence": 1.0 } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?fever { {type: "Symptom", name: "Fever"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "temperature_range": "38-40°C", "common": true } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_data", "confidence": 0.9 } }

UPSERT { CONCEPT ?aspirin { {type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "molecular_formula": "C9H8O4", "risk_level": 2, "dosage": "325mg" } SET PROPOSITIONS { ("treats", {type: "Symptom", name: "Headache"}) ("treats", {type: "Symptom", name: "Fever"}) } } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_data", "confidence": 0.95 }

cases.name: a guard matching the current version writes
cases.command: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?c { {type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"} EXPECT VERSION 1 SET ATTRIBUTES { "risk_level": 3 } } }

cases.name: a stale guard aborts the whole statement
cases.command: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?a { {type: "Symptom", name: "Headache"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "severity": "severe" } } CONCEPT ?c { {type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"} EXPECT VERSION 1 SET ATTRIBUTES { "risk_level": 4 } } }

cases.name: neither block of the aborted statement was applied
EXPECT VERSION 0 fails on an element that already exists
cases.command: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?c { {type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"} EXPECT VERSION 0 SET ATTRIBUTES { "risk_level": 9 } } }

cases.name: EXPECT VERSION 0 succeeds when the element does not exist yet
cases.command: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?c { {type: "Drug", name: "Naproxen"} EXPECT VERSION 0 SET ATTRIBUTES { "risk_level": 2 } } }

cases.name: a proposition guard follows the same contract when stale
cases.command: UPSERT { PROPOSITION ?p { ({type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"}, "treats", {type: "Symptom", name: "Headache"}) EXPECT VERSION 7 SET ATTRIBUTES { "effectiveness": 0.9 } } }

cases.name: a proposition guard matching the current version writes
cases.command: UPSERT { PROPOSITION ?p { ({type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"}, "treats", {type: "Symptom", name: "Headache"}) EXPECT VERSION 1 SET ATTRIBUTES { "effectiveness": 0.9 } } }
